models: Unchanged B0 and all6 fixed1280 terminal models; no checkpoint/prompt selection

writer.entrypoint: train.batched_causal_decoder.BatchedGreedyDecoder; original GreedyDecoder for residual serial rows
writer.support: Tokenizer-defined rows,matching existing GreedyDecoder; likelihood uses full released vocabulary.
writer.batches: Equal real prompt lengths only; batches8/4 and serial residuals,no fake duplicate examples or truncation.
writer.notes: Exactly one greedy note per question/model; raw actions,content,text,stop,error,cap and actual cost retained. No resampling or selection by quality.

reader.forced_closure: Full native Answer boundary appended after exact note content,including cap/EOS notes; original stop preserved.
reader.donor: Sort original item IDs by SHA256 of v29-other:+item_id,then cyclically rotate by1; whole intact same-model note, no fixed points or length/outcome selection.
reader.oracle: verified_work(prefix_ids,tokenizer); full trace includes root answer; plumbing control only.
reader.corrupt: Same verified trace,replace only last computed root value by exact rational value+1. This is a one-value error in the final computation state,not a partial-trace mechanism test.
reader.full_model_binding: Actual terminal active BF16 checkpoint upcast to FP32 for inference; full model-file SHA and native distributions checked.

ordinary.scorer: Same qualified score_spans; original528 IDs,firstID as context and all527 remaining IDs as targets.
ordinary.primary: Per-document mean NLL over all527 transitions
ordinary.suffix16: Exact last16 scores from same full-window vector; independent suffix check passed.

scalar.decoder: Original train.evaluate.GreedyDecoder,greedy32 actions,prefill672,EOS-only stop,no answer-line stopping.
scalar.note: A capped source continuation may still contain a complete initial scalar under the frozen parser. Report both parser status and cap; never silently count unsupported values as valid.

native_checks: Every actual model/process binds full checkpoint/asset/source hashes and compares fixed TRAIN full-head CPU FP32 references; KL<=.01,max_logp_error<=.001. Cached first-token versus full causal vector also checked before held generation. Existing FP32 greedy128 and full527 hardware qualifications support these shapes.
failure_policy: Retain all attempted rows and original partial generations. No result gate on a missing/incomplete required endpoint. No posthoc parser or tolerance rescue.
limits: FineMath calculation-targeted CPT,not broad language-model improvement.
Teacher root states contain the computed answer; oracle gains are not writer attainability or autonomous discovery.
Conditional paired intervals are not variation across model families/training histories.
